business_problem: Argano needed to more efficiently integrate newly-acquired specialty consulting firms into its portfolio, with the goal of unifying business units on a common solution to streamline operations and enhance visibility.
solution_summary: Argano built its Microsoft solution to improve cloud migration and platform modernization. Argano needed to more efficiently integrate newly-acquired specialty consulting firms into its portfolio, with the goal of unifying business units on a common solution to streamline operations and enhance visibility. Key components included Power BI delivered dashboards, apps, or copilots to users, and Azure Synapse Analytics held and organized governed data. Operational data flows into Azure Synapse Analytics, where Azure Synapse Analytics applies transformations and business logic before Power BI delivers governed insights to teams across Argano. The stack stayed governed and extensible on Microsoft. Dynamics 365 standardized reporting, improved productivity by 20%, simplified global time tracking, increased billing accuracy, and improved forecasting so leadership is prepared for new opportunities and business growth.

architecture_clues: In doing so, Argano was aiming to address various operational challenges that arose from such rapid growth: Decentralized financial data.

The use of separate systems, spreadsheets, and other tools for each business unit made it difficult to track company-wide pipeline, view who was working on which client projects, generate utilization reports, and manage project budgets accurately.

Leadership selected the following key platforms that the new solution would be built around: Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance and Project Operations Salesforce CRM for pipeline, marketing campaigns, and sales management Oracle HCM for human capital management These three pillars would bring all aspects of the business together, replacing less robust software tools.
